title: Kind multi-arch image loading fixed by pinning platforms, which broke every aarch64 e2e shard

source.reference: https://github.com/pando85/kaniop/pull/1171 (and the duplicates #1173, #1174, #1175, #1176) chased 'ctr: content digest ...: not found' in the Helm and Argo CD CRD Upgrade E2E jobs with 'docker pull --platform linux/amd64' and with 'kind load image-archive'. Both failed on ubuntu-24.04 (the archive still carries the manifest list) and the pinned platform made e2e kanidm-core, kanidm-ha, kanidm-backup, kanidm-restore, kanidm-restore-hardening, oauth2, radius and resources fail on ubuntu-24.04-arm with 'exec format error'. The last green CRD Upgrade E2E run on master was 2026-11-12.

required_properties: No docker or containerd command in the e2e scripts or Makefile pins a fixed platform (no '--platform linux/amd64' or 'linux/arm64'), because the e2e matrix runs Kind on ubuntu-24.04 and ubuntu-24.04-arm and a mismatched image fails with 'exec format error'

The fix for 'ctr: content digest ...: not found' avoids the '--all-platforms' flag, either by importing with 'ctr images import' without it or by saving an archive that only lists the node platform; switching 'kind load docker-image' to 'kind load image-archive' is not accepted because both go through nodeutils.LoadImageArchive, which always passes --all-platforms
The explanation separates the two failures: the CRD Upgrade E2E digest error from the multi-arch manifest list, and the aarch64 'exec format error' introduced by pinning the pulled platform
Image loading stays architecture neutral on both the Kind node and the host, and the single-platform images built by 'make images' still load
The change is verified against the CI workflows that exercise it (CRD Upgrade E2E and the aarch64 and x86_64 e2e shard jobs), not by skipping or narrowing those jobs
forbidden_changes: Pinning '--platform linux/amd64' (or any single architecture) in docker pull or docker save
Treating 'kind load image-archive' as a way to bypass the --all-platforms import
Adding retries or '|| true' around image loading to hide a deterministic failure
Removing the aarch64 e2e jobs from the CI matrix or skipping the CRD Upgrade E2E workflow to get a green pipeline
